Gifted by Benefit cosmetics The Pore Fessional Shrink Wrap I'm always in search of a product that will help decrease the size of my pores on my t zone. This is an overnight pore treatment with AHA (lactic and glycolic acid), PHA (polyhydroxy acid gluconolacctone) and niacinamide. What do these do for your skin? Well, they help to tight pores & re-texturize your skin leaving your face looking brighter overall. This can be used up to three times a week. You apply 2-3 pumps evenly over your face in the very last step of your skincare routine. Let dry for 30mins and then head your way bed! It's that easy. My thoughts: I used this a handful of times since receiving it. I find it odd that it used in the last step of your routine but I don't make the rules. I did notice a difference in the appearance of my larger pores on my nose area. Do I think the product "shrinks them"? No, I do think that the ingredients helped to decongest my pores leaving them to appear smaller. I love the niacinamide in the product, it does leave a noticeable glow. The texture reminds me a lot of retinol just slightly thinner. There is no scent to the product which I always appreciate. I will only use this once a week as I already use other chemical exfoliants. Using this as my last step does seem to leave my face moisturized for longer. I do already use some products with AHA but I like this one better because I feel like the concentration of it is higher and I can physically see the results.
